methodologyNotes: Of the 14 seed brands/models supplied, live research this session (direct manufacturer/retailer fetches, since general web search was unavailable) could only verify complete, current specifications for the Airthereal and OdorStop product lines — both companies run accessible, well-documented e-commerce sites with full spec sheets per SKU — while the rest of the seed list failed verification for concrete reasons: "Mammoth Air-3500" returned zero matching products anywhere and appears fabricated; Guardian Technologies' current catalog is HEPA/UV air purifiers only and explicitly markets itself as ozone-free, with no ozone generator ever offered; Ivation's live 163-product catalog has zero items in its own "Ozone Generator" category (the line appears discontinued); Coospider's current storefront (UV lamps, aquarium sterilizers, bug zappers) contains no ozone generator; and Enerzen's manufacturer domain (enerzen.com) now resolves to a parked domain-for-sale page, while Green Air Products' and A2Z Ozone's own sites returned "under construction"/403 responses and every major retailer (Amazon, Walmart, Home Depot, Zoro) blocked automated access outright, so VIVOSUN, Green Air ATLAS, A2Z Ozone MP-3000, Forlivese, and Croffek could not be corroborated against any live, fetchable product page and were excluded rather than sourced from an unverifiable or guessed URL. The 12-product roster below substitutes the full verifiable Airthereal (9 SKUs, 1,000-20,000 mg/h) and OdorStop (3 SKUs, 300-6,000 mg/h) lineups, each fetched directly from the manufacturer's own product page on 2026-08-12. Fields not published by the manufacturer (fan CFM, plate count, noise level, warm-up time on many SKUs) are left null rather than estimated; adjustable-output models report the published output range as a string rather than a single guessed figure.
